Once the Blades are at Sky Haven Temple (from The Throat of the World on) he lives there; in rain or snow his outdoor hours are spent inside the temple instead.
In Paarthurnax he and Delphine refuse to help you further until Paarthurnax is dead; the journal also lets you spare Paarthurnax and talk the Blades round instead.
